title: The Strawberries Incident
description: My girlfriend bought a pack of rare, expensive strawberries. I ate the biggest one without asking because it looked delicious. Now she isn't speaking to me and says I have no respect for her boundaries. Am I the jerk?
punishment: Buy her three boxes of organic strawberries and apologize in writing.

title: The Leftover Pizza
description: My roommate ate my leftover gourmet pizza that I specifically labeled with my name. In revenge, I hid his car keys for 2 hours, making him late for a doctor's appointment. Am I the jerk?
punishment: Clean the kitchen for two weeks and pay for his next pizza.

title: The Birthday Gift
description: I bought my boyfriend a high-end gym membership for his birthday. He got offended and thinks I am calling him out-of-shape. I was just trying to support his fitness goals. Am I the jerk?
punishment: Cancel the membership and buy him a nice video game instead.

title: The 5 AM Alarm
description: My roommate sets 5 alarms starting at 5:00 AM but sleeps through all of them, waking me up instead. Out of frustration, I threw her alarm clock out the window this morning. Am I the jerk?
punishment: Buy her a new alarm clock, but demand she uses a vibrating smartwatch instead.

title: The No-Kids Wedding
description: I am hosting a strict no-kids wedding. My sister says she won't attend if she can't bring her toddlers. I told her I will miss her there. My family says I am being selfish. Am I the jerk?
punishment: Stand your ground, but send her a nice dinner delivery on the wedding night.

title: The Office Thermostat
description: My coworker keeps turning the office AC down to 18°C (64°F) because he 'sweats easily'. I am freezing, so I hid the AC remote control in my drawer. Now the office is a heated debate. Am I the jerk?
punishment: Wear a cozy sweater, but make him buy you a hot coffee every morning.

title: The Dog Makeover
description: My partner went out of town and left their fluffy dog with me. The dog got muddy, so I shaved it. It looks like a completely different dog now, and my partner is crying. Am I the jerk?
punishment: Pay for a professional dog sweater and never touch the grooming clippers again.

title: Stealing the Baby Name
description: My cousin announced she wants to name her baby 'Aria'. I am pregnant too and due earlier, and I went ahead and named my baby Aria first. My cousin is furious and wants me to change it. Am I the jerk?
punishment: You got there first, but you owe her a baby shower gift of her choice.

title: The Ghosting Partner
description: My group project partner didn't contribute a single slide for our final presentation. I removed his name from the submission slides 5 minutes before presenting, causing him to fail. Am I the jerk?
punishment: Entirely justified. Celebrate your grade with some pizza.

title: The Airplane Recline
description: I reclined my seat on a 10-hour flight. The man behind me kept kicking my seat and saying he had no legroom. I refused to upright my seat. Am I the jerk?
punishment: Reclining is your right, but buy him a drink to soften the blow.
